notes.title: Space Sucks touched down at Pixel Power Play! 🚀🧼
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Vacuum-Powered Rebels,  

We had a total blast showing off our chaotic space cleaning sim during Toronto Games Week and meeting so many amazing players in person![/h3][p][/p][p]Watching you playing the demo in real time was everything we hoped for. Huge thanks to everyone who stopped by, gave it a try, and shared their thoughts![/p][p]We also brought our sugar-dusted horror game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932380/Sucronomicon/"]Sucronomicon[/url], and yes, cursed cookies were baked (and obliterated).[/p][p]Couldn’t make it to Toronto? No worries, you can still try the Sucronomicon demo on Steam!
🩷 [b]And don't forget to wishlist both games to stay updated and support our indie crew. 🩷[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With gratitude,
The Red Meat Games and Honig Studios Teams.[/p]
